request.text: Shuru mein ek student ne cake ke bare mein kaha 'hum part karte hain', aur aap ne us action ko 'taake us mein line na aaye' se joda. Phir, kareeb 7 minute par jab aap ne numerator/denominator pucha, ek student ne 'nomenator. denominator' kaha. In do alag palon mein, students ki soch kaise badli? Aur kal jab aap phir se 'part karna' ka real-life example dein, us pal par aap ek choti si kya cheez try karna chahengi?
